metas.name: Tulsa King
metas.description: New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi is released from prison after 25 years and exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a crew.

metas.name: Frisco King (upcoming)
metas.description: ⏳ Not yet released — status: In Production. After declining an assignment to kill Dwight Manfredi on behalf of New York mobsters, hitman Russell Lee Washington Jr. sets out to start a new life – and enterprise – in Frisco, Texas.
